acceptance_criteria.criterion: composer analyze completes with no new errors attributable to the new classes.
Any pre-existing PHPStan findings are not worsened.

summary: PHPStan analysis (`composer analyze`) completed on 2097 files. Zero errors attributable to the new icon builder classes (`src/classes/Application/Composer/IconBuilder/`, `src/classes/UI/Icons/`, and their corresponding tests). One pre-existing error in `src/classes/DBHelper/FetchMany.php` (line 39, method.childReturnType) was found — this originates from a prior unrelated commit (`bec3f1a6`: \"DBHelper: Added PDO primitive type return values.\") and is not worsened by the icon builder feature. Both acceptance criteria are satisfied.

comments.note: Pre-existing PHPStan error remains in `src/classes/DBHelper/FetchMany.php:39` (method.childReturnType — return type mismatch between DBHelper_FetchMany::fetch() and DBHelper_FetchOne::fetch()). This predates the icon builder feature (commit bec3f1a6). Recommend fixing in a dedicated DBHelper cleanup WP.
New test files (`tests/AppFrameworkTests/Composer/IconBuilder/` and `tests/AppFrameworkTests/UI/IconCollectionTest.php`) are untracked — PHPStan scanned them cleanly. No issues found in new code.

summary: PASS — Verification-only WP with no new code. PHPStan analysis scope and results are correct. Zero errors attributable to the icon builder or UI\Icons classes across 2097 files. The pre-existing DBHelper/FetchMany.php:39 method.childReturnType error is confirmed unrelated to this feature (originates from commit bec3f1a6, unchanged by this PR). All new classes (IconBuilder, IconDefinition, IconsReader, AbstractLanguageRenderer, PHPRenderer, JSRenderer, IconCollection, IconInfo) reviewed directly — all are clean, well-typed, and PHPStan-correct. No new code means QA's findings are the complete story; both acceptance criteria are met.

comments.note: Confirmed: DBHelper/FetchMany.php:39 method.childReturnType error is pre-existing. FetchMany::fetch() declares return type array<int,array<int|string,string|int|float|NULL>> while its parent FetchOne::fetch() has a different signature — the mismatch predates this PR and is unchanged. QA's characterisation is accurate.

No observations beyond the QA report — all new classes are architecturally sound and consistent with framework conventions. The code was thoroughly reviewed across each individual WP (WP-001 through WP-013) and in the integration WP-014 (which passed code-review PASS). PHPStan confirmation here closes the static analysis loop cleanly.

[documentation-forward] IconCollection::getByID() throws a bare \RuntimeException rather than the project's ApplicationException pattern. This was logged in WP-014's code-review pipeline and remains open. Module-level docs (CTX) should note the exception type, message format, and recommend calling idExists() before getByID() to avoid it.
